short_explanation: Treatment: randomized assignment to home exercise (control/reference) or supervised physical therapy.
Primary outcome: change from baseline to 6 weeks in the Zurich Claudication Questionnaire (ZCQ) symptom-severity score; negative values indicate improvement.
Secondary outcome: change from baseline to 6 weeks in the ZCQ physical-function score; negative values indicate improvement.
Secondary outcome: ZCQ treatment-satisfaction score at 6 weeks.
Secondary outcome: change from baseline to 6 weeks in back-pain numeric rating scale (NRS, 0-10); negative values indicate improvement.
Secondary outcome: change from baseline to 6 weeks in leg-pain NRS (0-10); negative values indicate improvement.
Secondary outcome: change from baseline to 6 weeks in leg-numbness NRS (0-10); negative values indicate improvement.
Secondary outcome: change from baseline to 6 weeks in self-paced walking-test distance, in metres.
Secondary outcome: change from baseline to 6 weeks in mean daily steps, in steps/day.
Baseline covariate: ZCQ symptom-severity score at week 0.
Baseline covariate: ZCQ physical-function score at week 0.
Baseline covariate: back-pain NRS at week 0 (0-10).
Baseline covariate: leg-pain NRS at week 0 (0-10).
Baseline covariate: leg-numbness NRS at week 0 (0-10).
Baseline covariate: self-paced walking-test distance at week 0, in metres.
Baseline covariate: mean daily steps at week 0, in steps/day.
Baseline covariate: age, in years.
Baseline covariate: participant sex (Female or Male).
Baseline covariate: body mass index, in kg/m².
Baseline covariate: duration of lumbar spinal stenosis symptoms, in months.
